symbols.name: sigma_psi
symbols.def: For \(\sigma\in\mathfrak S_2\), \(\sigma\psi\) replaces every type-indexed coordinate \(q_z\) by \(q_{\sigma^{-1}(z)}\) in both arms

symbols.name: Phi_one
symbols.def: \(\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)/\mathfrak S_2\) under simultaneous type permutation

symbols.name: I_one
symbols.type: joint sharp ATT image on the one-collision stratum

symbols.name: s
symbols.role: signs of the three noncollided terminal differences

symbols.name: y_prime
symbols.def: \(y^{\prime}\in\mathbb R^{10}\) is an independent copy of \(y\) used for pairwise target comparisons

symbols.name: G_branch
symbols.def: \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,\eta;y)\) is the explicit twelve-equality and finite-sign system in Definition \(\mathrm{def:ten-variable-system}\)

symbols.name: L_certificate
symbols.def: \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}(P,\eta)\) is the union of the Collins projection polynomials generated from \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\) and from every two-copy target-nonconstancy system comparing it with \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s',\sigma'}\), after all coordinates \(y,y'\) are eliminated and only \(P,\eta\) remain

symbols.name: rec_one
symbols.def: \(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,y)\) is the structural vector recovered from the terminal splits and positive-mass ratios in Definition \(\mathrm{def:ten-variable-system}\)

symbols.name: OneCAD
symbols.def: \(\mathsf{OneCollisionATT}(P,\eta)\) runs the fixed projection-and-lifting schedule in Definition \(\mathrm{def:one-collision-algorithm}\)

symbols.name: psi_diamond_sw
symbols.def: \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\) keeps the treated coordinates of \(\psi^{\diamond}\), swaps its two complete control components, and sets \(\pi=3/5\) and \(e_1=e_2=1/2\)

symbols.name: C_diamond
symbols.def: \(\mathcal C_\eta^{\diamond}=\{P:\operatorname{sgn}g(P,\eta)=\operatorname{sgn}g(P^{\diamond},\eta)\text{ for every }g\in\mathscr L_{0,\mathrm{id}}\cup\mathscr L_{0,\mathrm{sw}}\}\) is viewed as a relatively open cell in its support variety, which includes \(\chi_{00}^{01}=\chi_{00}^{10}=\chi_{00}^{11}=0\)

symbols.name: CertificateHandle
symbols.def: Handle: eliminate the four split variables first with the two-by-two rank equations, organize the resulting gcd alternatives by signed subresultant sequences, and use the full \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) CAD certificate to certify or refute every proposed deletion

symbols.name: C_tau
symbols.def: \(\mathcal C_{n,k_0}^{\tau}=\bigcup_{Q\in\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}:\lVert Q-\widehat P_n\rVert_\infty\le\delta_n(\alpha)}\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(Q)\)

novel.justification: Any data-generating process with nondegenerate latent shares, assignment probabilities, and transition rows satisfies this compact-interior restriction for some smaller rational \(\eta\). Rationality permits exact input encoding, while the box makes every stratum-restricted image attained. This condition is maintained independently and is not attributed to Ahn--Kasahara's common-support condition.

standard.name: Two-type first-order latent Markov path factorization with treatment-arm transition independence

novel.justification: The common box is credible in applications without nearly deterministic type shares, selection, or transitions. It is stronger than bounding treatment assignment alone and is maintained transparently to define a compact sensitivity model, not to claim coverage of the full published class.

The exclusive stratum contains observed laws for which every compatible compact-box representation has the same single control-row collision while the other three terminal rows remain distinct. Such pooling is natural when latent groups share one next-state probability but differ elsewhere. Exclusivity makes the named stratum a complete causal model rather than a selected representation and, by compactness of the global fiber, keeps its noncollided gaps bounded away from zero at each law.

definitions.name: Labeled and quotient global transition-alignment fibers
definitions.construction: \(\widetilde\Phi_\eta(P)=\{\psi\in\Theta_\eta:F(\psi)=P\}\) and \(\Phi_\eta(P)=\widetilde\Phi_\eta(P)/\mathfrak S_2\), where \(\mathfrak S_2\) acts by simultaneous type permutation

definitions.name: Quotient-induced sharp ATT image on the completed stratum
definitions.construction: \(\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\{\psi\in\Theta_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}:F(\psi)=P\}\), \(\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)/\mathfrak S_2\), \(\bar\tau_P([\psi])=\tau(\psi;P)\), and \(\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\{\bar\tau_P([\psi]):[\psi]\in\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\}\), with \(\mathcal I_{k_0,t}^{1\mathrm c}(P)=\operatorname{proj}_t\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\)

definitions.name: Ten-variable terminal-splitting systems
definitions.construction: For fixed \(k_0\in\mathcal A\), \(s\in\{-1,1\}^{3}\), and \(\sigma\in\Sigma\), first impose \(\chi_{0k_0}^{01}=\chi_{0k_0}^{10}=\chi_{0k_0}^{11}=0\) and set \(v_{10k_0}=v_{20k_0}=N_0(0,0,k_0)/H_0(0,0,k_0)\). Retain \(r_{ij}=R_{10}(i,j,k_0)\), set \(R_{20}(i,j,k_0)=H_0(i,j,k_0)-r_{ij}\), and for each of the other three blocks set \(R_{1d}(i,j,k)=[N_d(i,j,k)-v_{2dk}H_d(i,j,k)]/(v_{1dk}-v_{2dk})\) and \(R_{2d}=H_d-R_{1d}\). The free coordinate is exactly \(y=(v_{110},v_{210},v_{111},v_{211},v_{10,1-k_0},v_{20,1-k_0},r_{00},r_{01},r_{10},r_{11})\in\mathbb R^{10}\). The system \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,\eta;y)\) contains the eight cleared equalities \(\rho_{zdj}(R)=0\), the four cleared equalities \(\gamma_{zi}^{\sigma}(R)=0\), the three strict orientation signs \(s_{dk}(v_{1dk}-v_{2dk})>0\), \(R_{zd}(i,j,k)\ge\eta^5\), and both cleared signs \(q-\eta\ge0\) and \(U-q\ge0\) for every reconstructed \(q\in\{v_{zdk},u_{zd},a_{zi},\kappa_{zd3j},\pi_z,e_z\}\). Reconstruction uses \(T_{zd}^{R}(i,j)=\sum_kR_{zd}(i,j,k)\), \(S_{zd}^{R}(i)=\sum_jT_{zd}^{R}(i,j)\), \(w_{zd}=\sum_iS_{zd}^{R}(i)\), \(u_{zd}=S_{zd}^{R}(1)/w_{zd}\), \(a_{zi}=T_{z1}^{R}(i,1)/S_{z1}^{R}(i)\), \(\kappa_{zd3j}=R_{zd}(0,j,1)/T_{zd}^{R}(0,j)\), \(\pi_z=p_0w_{\sigma(z),0}+p_1w_{z1}\), and \(e_z=p_1w_{z1}/\pi_z\). Every cleared denominator is one of the explicitly positive quantities \(H_d,T_{zd}^{R},S_{zd}^{R},w_{zd},p_d\) or an orientation-signed terminal difference.

definitions.name: Observable one-collision sign certificate
definitions.construction: Order \(y\) as displayed in \(\mathrm{def:ten-variable-system}\). For each \(s\), apply Collins projection recursively: at each coordinate adjoin all coefficients, leading coefficients, discriminants, pairwise resultants, and signed principal subresultant coefficients of every equality against every inequality boundary in \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\), then delete that coordinate. Adjoin the three collision minors and the two collided-row box numerators. To test target constancy, for every \(s'\) and \(\sigma'\in\Sigma\), form a second copy \(y'\), impose both branch systems, and adjoin the cleared strict inequality \(\sum_{t=3}^{4}[\tau_t(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,y);P)-\tau_t(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s',\sigma'}(P,y');P)]^2>0\). Project every coordinate in \(y,y'\), leaving polynomials only in the observable cells of \(P\) and \(\eta\). The finite list \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}(P,\eta)\) is the union of these feasibility and nonconstancy projection polynomials over all eight \(s\). Its certificate records the sign of every member and the signed Sturm--Habicht lifting table, including zero cells. Feasibility and equality of both ATT coordinates across all branches are decided by exact sign-invariant lifting, with a retained sample point or a first violated sign attached to every decision.

definitions.name: Exact one-collision ATT algorithm
definitions.construction: \(\mathsf{OneCollisionATT}(P,\eta)\) takes reduced rational encodings of \(\eta\) and the thirty-two cells of \(P\); enumerates exactly \(2\cdot2^3\cdot2=32\) labeled branches \((k_0,s,\sigma)\); builds each ten-variable system \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}\); performs the fixed Collins projection and signed Sturm--Habicht lifting in \(\mathrm{def:observable-sign-certificate}\); and projects each retained cell through \(\tau(\operatorname{rec}_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,y);P)\). The joint image is returned as a quantifier-free Boolean combination of integer-polynomial sign conditions in \((\tau_3,\tau_4)\). Each marginal is returned as an ordered finite union of closed intervals and isolated points whose endpoints have a square-free integer polynomial, rational isolating interval, and Thom sign sequence. Every endpoint carries a reconstructed real-algebraic \(\psi\) and its \((k_0,s,\sigma)\) label; every discarded branch carries an exact sign or polynomial infeasibility certificate.

definitions.name: Exact rational one-collision benchmark
definitions.construction: Use the fully specified rational vectors \(\psi^{\diamond}\) and \(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\) in the symbol table and set \(P^{\diamond}=F(\psi^{\diamond})=F(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}})\). The control terminal row after state \(0\) is \((1/2,1/2)\), its row after state \(1\) is \((7/10,2/5)\), and both treated terminal rows are distinct.

definitions.name: Analytic certificate-compression handle
definitions.construction: Use \(\mathsf{CertificateHandle}\): eliminate the four collided-block split coordinates through the rank-one determinant equations, branch only on their signed subresultant gcd alternatives, and audit any reduced list against the complete \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) sign table.

definitions.name: Finite-sample full-PMF inversion
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal C_{n,k_0}^{\tau}=\bigcup_{Q\in\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}:\lVert Q-\widehat P_n\rVert_\infty\le\delta_n(\alpha)}\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(Q)\), where \(\delta_n(\alpha)=\sqrt{\log(64/\alpha)/(2n)}\)

statements.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_\eta\), \(\psi\in\widetilde\Phi_\eta(P)\), and \(\sigma\in\mathfrak S_2\), one has \(F(\sigma\psi)=P\) and \(\tau(\sigma\psi;P)=\tau(\psi;P)\). The map \(\bar\tau_P([\psi])=\tau(\psi;P)\) is therefore well defined on \(\Phi_\eta(P)\) and on every \(\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\).
statements.justification: The causal image is meaningful only after simultaneous latent labels are removed without changing aggregate ATT.
statements.gap: Regular mixture identification is commonly stated up to labels, but the quotient-induced causal functional must still be checked before singular branch images are pooled.
statements.consumer: The public \(ak\) package may report endpoint witnesses with arbitrary latent labels without changing the reported ATT set.

statements.statement: For every rational \(\eta\in(0,3/20)\), \(k_0\in\mathcal A\), and \(P\in\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}\), terminal splitting induces a surjection from the union of the sixteen feasible \((s,\sigma)\) ten-variable solution sets \(\{y:\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,\eta;y)\}\) onto \(\widetilde\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\), and two reconstructed points have the same image exactly when they differ by simultaneous type permutation or by duplicate boundary labels. Thus the forty-coordinate existential description in \((R,v)\in\mathbb R^{32}\times\mathbb R^8\) is exactly reduced to six terminal coordinates and four prefix splits. Across \(k_0\in\mathcal A\) there are exactly thirty-two labeled \((k_0,s,\sigma)\) branches. Rank failures and all \(\eta\)-box contacts occur as zero or weak-sign cells inside these systems and create no omitted branch.
statements.justification: This is the structural reduction that makes the singular causal fiber auditable and supplies the exact thirty-two-branch inventory.
statements.gap: Geiger and Meek's Sections 2 and 3.2--3.4 supply general real quantifier elimination for polynomial latent-variable models, observable constraints, identification, and bounds, but do not expose this model's forty-to-ten terminal-splitting reduction. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 identifies finite Markov-mixture primitives from four consecutive observations under their Assumptions 1--3; its rank and separation conditions exclude rather than classify the coupled-arm one-collided-control-row fiber.
statements.consumer: A branch checker for \(ak\) can certify that a one-collision search neither drops a rank-zero solution nor counts an orientation boundary as infeasible.

statements.statement: For every \(P\in\Delta_{31}\), \(k_0\in\mathcal A\), and \(\sigma\in\Sigma\), the signed list \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}(P,\eta)\) is observable and finite. Its sign vector and signed Sturm--Habicht lifting table are necessary and sufficient for each of the eight oriented systems \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,\eta;y)\) to have a real solution. After combining the two relative alignments, \(\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\) is a singleton if and only if every accepted cell has zero oscillation in both reconstructed coordinates \(\tau_3\) and \(\tau_4\) and the two alignment images coincide. If this condition fails, the same certificate returns two accepted cells and reconstructed latent witnesses having unequal ATT vectors. These equivalences include vanishing rank coefficients, alignment coincidences, and every compact-box face.
statements.justification: This is the requested observable necessary-and-sufficient point-identification classification on the completed merger stratum.
statements.gap: Ahn--Kasahara's Proposition 4 identifies parameters under RSM, M, and ID, and their Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions; those results do not classify ATT constancy after one terminal collision. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 identifies a finite mixture of Markov chains from four consecutive observations under their Assumptions 1--3, including an observable rank condition and type-separating walk conditions, but does not classify this coupled-arm collision fiber or its aggregate-ATT image. Geiger and Meek's Sections 3.3--3.4 show how real quantifier elimination obtains implicit observable constraints and answers identification or bounding questions for polynomial models, without the present causal branch labels or reconstructed counter-witness grammar.
statements.consumer: The Dodd--Frank, Norwegian patenting, and ADA analyses can distinguish an observed-law ATT sign from a sign induced by one arbitrary cross-arm merger resolution.

statements.statement: For rational \(\eta\) and rational \(P\in\mathcal M_{\eta,0}^{1\mathrm c}\cup\mathcal M_{\eta,1}^{1\mathrm c}\), \(\mathsf{OneCollisionATT}(P,\eta)\) terminates after examining exactly thirty-two labeled \((k_0,s,\sigma)\) branches and returns, for each \(k_0\), exactly the attained joint image \(\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\) as a quantifier-free semialgebraic formula. It returns each nonempty \(\mathcal I_{k_0,t}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\) as a finite ordered union of closed intervals and isolated points with Thom-encoded real-algebraic endpoints, a reconstructed feasible latent representation for every endpoint and isolated component, and an exact infeasibility certificate for every discarded branch. The theorem claims equivalence to Collins real quantifier elimination after the proved ten-coordinate reduction and claims no improvement in generic worst-case CAD complexity.
statements.justification: The theorem turns a singular point-identification failure into an exact attained causal region without convexifying disconnected components.
statements.gap: Duarte and coauthors provide successively refined polynomial-program outer bounds and \(\epsilon\)-sharpness, while Collins CAD provides general exact elimination; neither result supplies this reduced transition-alignment system, its fixed branch inventory, or causal endpoint witnesses.
statements.consumer: The \(ak\) package receives a terminating exact-arithmetic backend for the completed singular stratum and can display the latent representation attaining each reported endpoint.

statements.statement: For every rational \(0<\eta<3/20\), \(P^{\diamond}\in\mathcal M_{\eta,0}^{1\mathrm c}\), \(\psi^{\diamond},\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\in\Theta_{\eta,0}^{1\mathrm c}\), and \(F(\psi^{\diamond})=F(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}})=P^{\diamond}\). The global and one-collision quotient fibers coincide and have exactly two classes. Their ATT vectors are \((9/250,-33/2500)\) and \((-1/500,49/5000)\), so \(\mathcal I_{0,3}^{1\mathrm c}(P^{\diamond})=\{-1/500,9/250\}\) and \(\mathcal I_{0,4}^{1\mathrm c}(P^{\diamond})=\{-33/2500,49/5000\}\). Moreover, \(\mathcal C_\eta^{\diamond}\) is a nonempty relatively open sign chamber in the named collision variety; every law in a relative neighborhood of \(P^{\diamond}\) within that chamber has two separated quotient ATT components with the same branch labels and coordinatewise ordering.
statements.justification: A rational witness and a relatively open singular chamber show that disconnected geometry is structural rather than a numerical artifact at one isolated law.
statements.gap: Generic label-switching observations do not establish a causal ATT gap after quotienting simultaneous labels, and the cited mixture papers provide no one-collision open chamber with exact values.
statements.consumer: Regression tests for \(ak\) can verify exact branch retention and prevent software from replacing two attainable values by their interval hull.

statements.statement: Under independent multinomial sampling, for every \(n\ge1\), \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}}P^n\{\mathcal I_{k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\subseteq\mathcal C_{n,k_0}^{\tau}\}\ge1-\alpha\). The event covers both marginal identified sets simultaneously. No endpoint-consistency, Hausdorff-consistency, or branch-persistence conclusion is asserted.
statements.justification: Finite-sample full-PMF inversion provides honest coverage of every disconnected component without choosing a latent branch.
statements.gap: Romano--Shaikh develops general inference for identified sets under stated pointwise and uniform conditions; this auxiliary result uses finite multinomial concentration to cover the entire completed-stratum image and deliberately makes no topology-consistency claim.
statements.consumer: Applied analyses can attach a finite-sample honest region to the exact singular identified set while clearly separating coverage from set estimation.

statements.statement: Can the complete Collins projection list \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) be reduced to a strictly smaller, economically interpretable and irredundant collection of observable minors and signed resultants that still determines branch feasibility and singleton aggregate ATT on \(\mathcal M_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}\)? Establish sufficiency of the reduced list and prove irredundancy by constructing, for every retained sign, two rational laws agreeing on all other proposed signs but differing in feasibility or ATT constancy.
statements.justification: The exact certificate is finite and computable, but a minimal observable diagnostic would reveal which empirical path restrictions actually govern point identification.
statements.gap: Neither general CAD theory nor latent-mixture identification results isolate an irredundant causal sign basis for this one-collision stratum.
statements.consumer: The public \(ak\) interface could replace a large algebraic certificate by a concise diagnostic explaining which observed cell relation creates the ATT ambiguity.

sampling_model.design: Independent multinomial sampling of the complete observed path \(W=(X_1,X_2,X_3,X_4,D)\).
sampling_model.treatment: Binary \(D\), with treatment beginning after date \(2\).
sampling_model.overlap: Every mixing, conditional assignment, and transition probability in the proposal-specific model lies in \([\eta,1-\eta]\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical thirty-two-cell path PMF is inverted over all thirty-two labeled one-collision branches; no relative alignment is selected before projection.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Proposition 4 identifies the model parameters under RSM, M, and ID; Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the paper's stated TI--LT regular conditions.
Theorem 1 identifies type-specific initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations under Assumptions 1--3.
Sections 3.2--3.4 formulate model comparison, implicit observable constraints, identification, and bounding for polynomial latent-variable models through real quantifier elimination.
Cylindrical algebraic decomposition gives an exact quantifier-elimination method for formulas over real closed fields.
CAD-based real quantifier elimination has doubly exponential worst-case dependence on dimension, while other real-algebraic methods address selected tasks with different bounds.
A rational inverse and semialgebraic membership conditions characterize regular parts of a single binary hidden Markov model, with exceptional cases treated as lower-dimensional submodels.
Discrete causal bounds can be posed as polynomial programs and approximated by spatial branch-and-bound with certified outer bounds and \(\epsilon\)-sharpness.
Finite mixtures are exactly partially identified under an excluded source of mixture-weight variation using probability restrictions.
Criterion inversion yields confidence regions for identified sets and their images under stated pointwise and uniform conditions.

tldr: On the compact binary four-period latent-transition model, the singular case with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row admits an exact observable treatment. Terminal splitting reduces the forty-coordinate existential fiber to displayed ten-variable systems and exactly thirty-two collided-state, orientation, and relative-alignment branches. A Collins-style sign certificate is necessary and sufficient for branch feasibility and aggregate-ATT point identification; the associated exact algorithm returns the attained, possibly disconnected image with Thom-encoded endpoints, latent witnesses, and discarded-branch certificates. A relatively open singular sign chamber and a rational law with two separated ATT values show that the geometry is not isolated. The contribution is this structural reduction and causal certificate grammar, not a generic CAD complexity improvement, a completion of the other collision patterns, or an overlap theorem for Ahn--Kasahara's regular class.

project_justification.gap: Ahn--Kasahara's parameter and ATT identification results impose their stated RSM, M, ID, and TI--LT regular conditions, while Higgins and Jochmans's four-observation Theorem 1 requires rank, type-separation, and connectivity conditions; neither classifies the one-collided-control-row merger stratum. Geiger--Meek and Collins supply general real quantifier elimination but leave the economically meaningful two-arm branch structure opaque.
project_justification.niche: Exactly one collided control terminal row is the first nonregular stratum on which full-path splitting, rank failure, probability-box contact, and relative treatment-control alignment interact but remain reducible to ten variables.
project_justification.fill: The project proves the reduction, gives the observable \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\) classification, computes the exact attained ATT image on all thirty-two labeled branches, and supplies an open singular chamber plus rational disconnected benchmark.

related_work: Ahn--Kasahara is the closest econometric comparator in the same full-path latent-transition model: their Proposition 4 identifies the parameters under RSM, M, and ID, while their Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions. Those results inform the estimand and model architecture; no theorem here asserts equality on, inclusion in, or an extension of their regular class. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 identifies type-specific initial distributions, transition kernels, and mixing probabilities up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations under Assumptions 1--3: the observable matrices have the required rank, return-walk profiles separate types, and a common reference state is connected to every other state. That theorem supplies the closest four-observation Markov-mixture identification benchmark, but it does not classify a two-treatment-arm transition-alignment fiber when one control terminal row collides, project an aggregate ATT image, or reconstruct its endpoint representations. Critch's binary hidden Markov geometry motivates rational splitting and semialgebraic membership, but it has neither two treatment arms nor a causal alignment functional. Geiger and Meek provide the methodological bridge: Theorems 1 and 2 in Section 2 state real quantifier elimination and semialgebraic projection, while Sections 3.2--3.4 formulate model comparison, implicit equality and inequality constraints, identification, and bounds for polynomial latent-variable models. Their machinery is generic and supplies neither the two-arm transition-alignment fiber, the observable one-collided-control-row branch certificate, a causal ATT image, nor reconstructed endpoint representations. Collins's cylindrical algebraic decomposition is the closest exact certification engine, and Basu's survey fixes the relevant worst-case complexity benchmark; the gain here is solely the proved structural dimension reduction and branch-labeled causal output. Duarte, Finkelstein, Knox, Mummolo, and Shpitser motivate polynomial optimization for sharp discrete causal bounds, but their general routine returns successively refined outer bounds rather than the present exact attained semialgebraic image. Henry, Kitamura, and Salanie characterize a different exclusion-driven finite-mixture set. Romano--Shaikh motivates set inversion; the auxiliary coverage result here is finite-sample and deliberately excludes Hausdorff or endpoint-persistence claims.
technical_internal_limitation: The completed object is the stratum with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row. Laws whose global compact fiber also contains representations from another collision pattern are outside this class. The certificate uses exact Collins-style projection after model-specific reduction and may retain the generic worst-case cost of real quantifier elimination.
honest_scope: The quotient semantics, forty-to-ten reduction, thirty-two-branch classification, exact stratum-restricted region, disconnected benchmark, and finite-sample coverage are to be proved. The remaining open content is whether the complete CAD projection list can be compressed to a smaller irredundant and interpretable observable sign basis. Ahn--Kasahara's regular identification results are comparators only: no internal overlap-equality, model-inclusion, or regular-chart theorem is claimed. No result is claimed for the other terminal-collision strata, for an unboxed singular class, or for Hausdorff consistency.

S3: critical-\(\eta\) phase diagram for topology and endpoint switches

S6: generic cross-arm alignment ambiguity with disconnected ATT sets

S8: exact common-prehistory merger bounds and sign-robustness threshold

seed_details.seed: Directed one-collision root angle from S1 and S2
seed_details.question: On the compact binary four-period model, can the singular stratum with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row be classified by observable signs and can its exact attained aggregate-ATT image be computed with branch-labeled certificates?
seed_details.structural_difference: The object is the single-collision semialgebraic fiber represented by ten free coordinates and thirty-two labeled branches; other collision patterns and Hausdorff behavior lie outside the claim.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace regular eigendecomposition and the forty-coordinate structural existential system by terminal splitting: six noncollided terminal probabilities and four collided-block prefix splits remain, after which rank-one and cross-arm equations are imposed before Collins projection.

seed_details.settled_vs_open: Real quantifier elimination guarantees decidability of the reduced systems. Geiger and Meek's Sections 2 and 3.2--3.4 make that generic polynomial-model route explicit. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 identifies finite Markov-mixture primitives from four observations under rank, type-separation, and connectivity conditions. Ahn--Kasahara's Proposition 4 identifies parameters under RSM, M, and ID, and their Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions. None supplies the model-specific ten-coordinate reduction, the thirty-two causal alignment branches, the one-collision observable certificate grammar, or an attained disconnected aggregate-ATT output. Compression of the resulting certificate to an interpretable irredundant minor list remains open.
seed_details.closer_paper_check: Ahn--Kasahara remains the closest comparator for the causal estimand and coupled-arm model. literature_map: Ahn--Kasahara's Proposition 4 identifies the latent-transition parameters under RSM, M, and ID, and their Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions. These results are comparators for the model architecture and estimand, not the target of an internal overlap theorem. Higgins and Jochmans's Section 2, Theorem 1 identifies type-specific initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation from four consecutive observations under Assumptions 1--3: an observable rank condition, distinct type-specific return-walk profiles, and a common-state connectivity condition. It does not classify the coupled-arm singular collision fiber or an aggregate ATT image. Critch gives a rational inverse and semialgebraic membership analysis for a single binary hidden Markov model but does not couple treatment arms or project a causal functional. Geiger and Meek's Theorems 1 and 2 in Section 2 state quantifier elimination over real closed fields and semialgebraic projection; Sections 3.2--3.4 then apply the framework to comparison of polynomial latent-variable models, implicit observable equality and inequality constraints, identification, and bounds. This supplies generic algebraic and quantifier-elimination machinery, not a two-treatment-arm transition-alignment fiber, a one-collided-control-row observable branch certificate, a causal ATT image, or reconstructed endpoint representations. Collins gives exact quantifier elimination by cylindrical algebraic decomposition, and Basu's survey records CAD's doubly exponential worst-case dependence on dimension; the present algorithm uses that machinery after a proved forty-to-ten coordinate reduction and makes no generic complexity improvement claim. Duarte, Finkelstein, Knox, Mummolo, and Shpitser reduce discrete causal bounds to polynomial programs with certified \(\epsilon\)-sharp outer bounds, whereas the fixed one-collision problem permits exact attained output with branch labels and latent endpoint witnesses. Henry, Kitamura, and Salanié exactly characterize a different finite-mixture identified set under exclusion-driven weight variation. These adjacent threads leave the one-collided-control-row transition-alignment fiber and its aggregate-ATT image open.

novelty_justification: The closest econometric comparator is Ahn--Kasahara: Proposition 4 identifies the parameter vector under RSM, M, and ID, while Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions. Those results inform this independently compactified one-collision analysis but are not theorem-level targets. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 is the closest four-observation finite Markov-mixture identification theorem: under Assumptions 1--3 it recovers the initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation, but it does not classify the coupled-arm singular collision fiber or aggregate ATT. Geiger and Meek's Theorems 1--2 in Section 2 and applications in Sections 3.2--3.4 provide the exact bridge from polynomial latent-variable models to implicit constraints, identification, bounds, and real quantifier elimination; they do not supply the model-specific two-arm branch system or causal output grammar. Collins-style real quantifier elimination remains the closest exact algorithmic comparator. The advance is not a new generic CAD complexity bound. It is a proved causal reduction from the forty lifted prefix-and-terminal coordinates to the displayed ten-variable systems, a complete inventory of thirty-two \(k_0\)-orientation-alignment branches, an observable sign certificate \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\), and exact branch-labeled ATT output with Thom-encoded endpoints and reconstructed witnesses. No inclusion between the compact class and Ahn--Kasahara's published class is asserted.
